title: Morning Brief, Sat 21 Nov 2026: Nitish Setu (the Kachchi Dargah-Bidupur six-lane extradosed cable-stayed Ganga bridge, Patna-Vaishali) is dedicated to the nation today; PM Modi visits it at about 1:15 PM (PMO schedule) as part of ~Rs 34,470 crore of projects in Vaishali; PMO: ~Rs 4,280 crore, 9.7 km main bridge + 10 km approaches, eases Mahatma Gandhi Setu and JP Setu; RJD objects to naming it after a living leader (lead); Eastern Railway (20 Nov, per Railway Board advisory) warns loud calls / speaker-mode media on trains may draw action under Railways Act s.145 as substituted by the Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Act 2026: Rs 1,000 fine for nuisance, persisting after being told to stop up to 6 months' simple imprisonment and/or up to Rs 5,000 fine; Southern Railway warned in October; Rajasthan panchayat polls: Congress won more Panchayat Samiti seats than the BJP in 33 of 37 counted districts (SEC, late Fri), BJP ahead in Ajmer, Balotra, Salumber, Udaipur; Nepal PM Balendra Shah's first India visit 22-23 Nov, talks with Modi 23 Nov (MEA); KL Rahul's first Test hundred in New Zealand, 1st Test Wellington Day 3, India replying to NZ 368, Padikkal 80.
headline: Nitish Setu, Bihar's 9.7-Km Ganga Bridge, Opens Today; Modi Visits 1:15 PM

fact_sources.fact: PM Modi visits Nitish Setu in Vaishali at about 1:15 PM on 21 Nov and dedicates it to the nation, among projects worth about Rs 34,470 crore in Vaishali (event at about 2 PM)

Nitish Setu: six-lane extradosed cable-stayed bridge over the Ganga linking Kachchi/Kachhi Dargah (NH-22, Patna district) with Bidupur (NH-322, Vaishali); PMO: ~Rs 4,280 crore, 19.7 km project = 9.7 km main bridge + 10 km approach roads; eases Mahatma Gandhi Setu and JP Setu (DH, citing officials, gives Rs 5,500 crore and 9.76 km: so cost attributed to PMO)
Bihar government named the Kachchi Dargah-Bidupur bridge after former CM Nitish Kumar; RJD (Tejashwi Yadav and others) objects to naming it after a living leader

Eastern Railway (Fri 20 Nov), per a Railway Board advisory, told its four divisions to curb speaker-mode music/videos, loud or prolonged calls and loud ringtones on trains and at stations; cites Section 145 of the Railways Act; announcements urging earphones

Railways Act s.145(2) as substituted by the Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Act, 2026 (item 52(G); Gazette No. 13, 8 Apr 2026): nuisance = removal, ticket forfeited, fine of Rs 1,000; continuing after lawful injunction = simple imprisonment up to 6 months, or fine up to Rs 5,000, or both
Southern Railway issued a similar warning to its divisions in October 2026

Rajasthan panchayat polls (results 20 Nov, SEC): Congress won more Panchayat Samiti seats than the BJP in 33 of the 37 districts where counting was held; BJP ahead in Ajmer, Balotra, Salumber, Udaipur; Panchayat Samiti seats Congress 3,701 vs BJP 2,181 (NH, evening) / 3,758 vs 2,213 (HT, SEC tally 11:30 pm)

Nepal PM Balendra Shah's state visit 22-23 Nov, his first to India since taking office in March 2026; calls on President Murmu; talks with PM Modi on 23 Nov (MEA); agenda incl. development, energy, connectivity, technology

KL Rahul's century on Day 3 (after lunch) of the 1st Test in Wellington, his first Test innings/hundred in New Zealand; he now has Test hundreds in all four of South Africa, England, New Zealand and Australia
Devdutt Padikkal out for 80 (Kyle Jamieson); New Zealand made 368 in the first innings
